Swargate-Katraj underground metro: Excavation for shafts begins at multiple locations

Excavation for the shafts of the Swargate-Katraj underground metro has begun at multiple locations.

The actual TBM operations will start from September.

The 5.46-km Swargate-Katraj corridor will be Pune Metro’s first fully-underground extension. Metro authorities have set a target of December 2029 for completion of the corridor.
